g.text: An early deep study of surface language and construction, translating the segmented logic of
medieval armour into a moving metal form.
Medieval knight armour and dark-fantasy references established the project’s
language: aggression, protection and overlapping structure.
The central challenge was finding how rigid sheet-metal segments could
connect and still follow the hand. Joint ideas were tested through repeated cuts,
Finger components were cut, formed, drilled and linked by hand. Each trial
refined overlap, range of motion and continuity across the armoured surface.
The resolved gauntlet brings the joint experiments together as one wearable
construction—protective in expression, but articulated enough to move with
